# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- out has no extension check, unlike the reader verbs, sdrf design and proteins annotate-go (PYB-1). It writes an SDRF, conventionally .sdrf.tsv; should it share their .tsv-only rule? Behaviour unchanged until decided (noted on pyMzLib \#76).
